equipment.model: RB1000i-SA (RB1000 family) electrostatic rotary bell atomizer
equipment.role: Atomizer for solvent-borne metallic basecoat (direct charge)
equipment.rationale: Solvent-borne basecoat (2C1B, MET-3 metallic) is normally applied with high-speed direct-charge bells in bell1/bell2 metallic process. Representative.

equipment.model: EcoRP E043i robot + EcoBell3 rotary atomizer
equipment.role: Alternative representative robot/atomizer
equipment.rationale: Market-leading alternative; EcoBell3 supports exterior metallic basecoat, solvent- and water-borne. Representative.

equipment.role: Colour changer (12+ colours incl. all group C basecoats)
equipment.rationale: Atomizer-mounted/arm-mounted low-pressure colour changer with circulation to needle seat; fits multi-colour (12 basecoats) line. ABB CBS/integrated colour changer is equivalent if ABB line.

equipment.role: Paint kitchen and circulation loops for 180 L drums
equipment.rationale: Each high-volume basecoat colour typically has its own circulation loop from the paint mix room (drum 180 L -> mix tank -> pump -> loop); low-volume colours may use pigging. Representative; Graco/Dürr/ABB supply systems all common.

equipment.role: Alternative representative paint robot
equipment.rationale: FANUC paint robots common in Korean-built paint shops; FANUC is a confirmed equipment supplier to UzAuto Asaka (press shop 2023). Representative.
